bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; appropriating money for improvements to the Capitol tunnel.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; CAPITOL TUNNEL.

$8,500,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of administration to design, construct, and equip improvements to bring a portion of the tunnel under Rev. Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. Boulevard and to the east to the State Capitol into compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. This appropriation is onetime and is available until the project is completed or abandoned, subject to Minnesota Statutes, section 16A.642.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
additions: $8,500,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of administration to design, construct, and equip improvements to bring a portion of the tunnel under Rev. This appropriation is onetime and is available until the project is completed or abandoned, subject to Minnesota Statutes, section 16A.642.
This section is effective the day following final enactment.
